verdict.rationale: Sardine has its own API, with API references behind protected docs. Business verification is documented as available both in the dashboard and through the async /businesses API, so parity exists for at least one workflow. Several UI-centric features (the no-code rule editor, case management workspace, user invitations and new-verification forms) have no evidence of API equivalents, so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented UI–API parity claim, API coverage for rules, case management and admin/user management, a public API reference, and independent corroboration.
